title: Chapter 1475
text:
"What? Black Star and the three Universal Civilizations have reached a private agreement to develop the Sanctum together?! "

The Star Arc Leader's surprised voice sounded in the Supercluster Alliance's conference room.

A civilization leader nodded with a solemn expression. "I received some news. Black Star seems to have really shared the information of the Sanctum with the three Universal Civilizations."

"Is the news reliable?" The Star Arc Leader's expression became serious.

"It's very credible."

Hearing this, the expressions of the Supercluster leaders changed.

The three Universal Civilizations did not hide Black Star's sharing of the Sanctum. This was not a secret that could not be found out, but they did not announce it to the public. After knowing the current situation, they did not have the intention to do so for the time being. Otherwise, they would have publicized it in order to increase their reputation.

The composition of the three Sanctum keys that Han Xiao had given out, as well as the purpose and method of entering the Sanctum, were the secrets that the three Universal Civilizations kept. Outsiders could not find out, so the Supercluster Alliance only knew the surface of the cooperation between the two sides to develop the Sanctum, but they did not know the specific reasons and details.

"This is really strange. The three Universal Civilizations, the Supers Holy Land, and us are already in a tripartite situation. The Sanctum is the core competitiveness of the Supers Holy Land. Isn't Black Star helping the enemy? What does he mean? "

The Star Arc Leader's face was filled with confusion.

"Indeed, I don't understand either. Why would Black Star need to share the Sanctum with the three Universal Civilizations?" Another civilization leader was confused. "In the past, when the Beyond Grade As were still in the association, they did not share the information of the Sanctum in the face of the suppression of the three Universal Civilizations. Now, the Supers Holy Land is already a giant organization. They are not inferior to the three Universal Civilizations at all. Why would they give out the information of the Sanctum? Could it be that the three Universal Civilizations have something on them? "

"I don't think Black Star can be threatened by the three Universal Civilizations. There must be other reasons. Black Star might have other motives … We can't even rule out the possibility of them reaching a deep strategic cooperation."

"The World Tree has already been dealt with. What other strategic cooperation can they have? Could it be that they are fighting that third-party spy? But is there a need for that? Be it the three Universal Civilizations or Black Star himself, they can deal with that Star Alliance alone, right? "

At this time, one of the civilization leaders hesitated and said carefully,

"… Have you ever considered that they might be working together to deal with us?"

As soon as he finished speaking, the room fell silent.

After a long while, the Star Arc Leader swallowed his saliva and probed, "Um … I don't think it's possible. We're the lubricant between them. They probably won't join forces to deal with us …"

"I don't think so …" Someone worriedly disagreed. "Could it be that our attitude of waiting for the best offer is too blatant and has angered both of them?"

Hearing this, everyone panicked and didn't know what to do.

After the post-war situation was established, they circled around between the three Universal Civilizations and the Supers Holy Land, jumping around repeatedly to maintain the balance.

Originally, according to the initial analysis, the three Universal Civilizations needed to form an alliance with them to keep the Supers Holy Land in check. Therefore, they would definitely 'change their ways' and take out a lot of benefits to rope them in. The initial trend was the same. They were finally no longer suppressed and had the space to develop freely. They used an alternative method to achieve their original motive for migrating.

Logically speaking, if not for the rise of the Supers Holy Land, the Supercluster would not have been able to do as they wished. Black Star had contributed to this, but due to the balance of power, they could not lean too close to the Supers Holy Land. Otherwise, the three Universal Civilizations would definitely explode. Therefore, they had no choice but to temporarily put aside the deep alliance agreement with Black Star and turn it into a shallow cooperation.

The Supers Holy Land did not say anything about this. They even specially called Black Star to apologize, and the other party expressed that he did not mind. Therefore, the Supercluster Alliance had always been very at ease and felt that there was no problem with this route. They hoped to maintain a good working relationship with both sides … However, now that Black Star and the three Universal Civilizations had done this, they immediately lost confidence.

This feeling was like there were two enemies who did not deal with each other, and he maintained a good relationship with both of them. As the glue of the three of them, he let everyone play together. However, one day, the two enemies suddenly reconciled and put their arms around each other's shoulders. They actually did not bring him along to play, and he became the third person who was isolated. This was very uncomfortable.

"I think we still need to analyze it, but we can't rule out that there's such a factor at play … We need to think about our attitude towards the Supers Holy Land and the three Universal Civilizations. We can't be too cold," the Star Arc Leader said with a heavy tone.

The more the upper echelons of the Supercluster thought about it, the more they felt guilty. They were paranoid and scared themselves.

…

In the unexplored universe, the capital of the Star Alliance.

"Ever since the World Tree fully invaded, the situation of the three Universal Civilizations has become more and more difficult. In nearly two years, they have already lost nearly 6% of their territory. Originally, I thought that they would be able to hold on for a few decades, but it seems like I overestimated them. The three Universal Civilizations can't resist the attack of the World Tree at all. With this trend, the three Universal Civilizations will definitely be completely defeated in five to six years, or even thirteen to fourteen years!"

In the conference room, the leader of the Star Alliance and the leaders of the allied civilizations all had smiles on their faces. The room was filled with joy.

In the past year or so when the World Tree invaded the galactic society, they had been living a very happy life. Even their walking was light. Every time they finished reading the 'battle report' sent by the spies, they would look forward to the next one because it was always full of surprises.

The more miserable the galactic society was, the happier they would be!

The leader of the Star Alliance knocked on the table and said with a smile, "In the past year or so, the three Universal Civilizations have almost been completely defeated by the World Tree. Black Star was ambushed and heavily injured, exceeding the upper limit of his Indestructible Body. He had no choice but to fall into a deep sleep and slowly recuperate. Therefore, the Sanctum Revival has been temporarily stopped. According to the intelligence, he is now the spiritual pillar of the galactic society against the foreign enemies. Once Black Star fell, the morale of the Galactic Alliance Army collapsed, and they were forced to retreat on the battlefield … Therefore, it's obvious that without Black Star, the galactic alliance army is just a bunch of mobs. "

"Hehe, not bad, not bad." The leader of the Lore Civilization, Savignes, chuckled. "Furthermore, the previous two battle reports said that the mother planets of the three Universal Civilizations were frequently attacked, and they had no choice but to let the upper echelons take refuge. During the voyage, the spaceship of the Red Empire was ambushed on a large scale, and the current leader, Marbruce, was cut in half at the waist. The previous ruler of the empire, Uranril, was captured by the members of the World Tree. It is said that the National Pillar, Clottey, was so angry that his eyes almost popped out of his head. He went to save her alone and was captured in the end. However, his will was firm. Therefore, the World Tree gathered the members and violated Uranril in front of him again and again, destroying Clottey's will. Only then did the World Tree devour him and turn him into a slave … "

"Speaking of which, the peak Beyond Grade As of the galactic society are either dead or injured. Manison's main body of the Mecha Empire was exposed and turned into a slave by the World Tree. All of his assets were used against the enemy. Kasuyi's mind was shattered and he became a fool. Wuornos was forced to participate in the battle, and the Ethereal national treasure was almost shattered …"

These battle reports were all made up by the spies who had already rebelled under the orders of Han Xiao. He had even added a lot of personal information into it. It was quite 'exciting' … As for the people involved in the battle reports, they did not know anything. They did not know that Han Xiao was making up stories about them.

The members of the Star Alliance talked about the good news in the previous battle reports with great interest. They could not wait to see the miserable lives of the people of the galactic society with their own eyes and laugh to their hearts' content.

Everyone chatted and laughed for a while. The leader of the Star Alliance restrained his expression, knocked on the table, and said seriously.

"Although the defeat of the three Universal Civilizations is a foregone conclusion, we have finally eliminated a huge threat and a competitor. However, the World Tree is a new threat. When the war ends, we still need to pay attention to the World Tree."

Savignes immediately agreed. "That's right. The failure of the three Universal Civilizations has already proven how terrifying they are. Even if we develop to the height of the three Universal Civilizations, we will not be their match."

"Hmm, but time is on our side. As long as we continue to develop, sooner or later …"

Just as the leader of the Star Alliance was about to look forward to the future to cheer everyone on, the conference room was suddenly knocked open.

Bang!

A secretary rushed in anxiously. His expression was extremely anxious, and there was a strong sense of panic in his eyes.

"Leaders, something bad has happened. Traces of the World Tree army have been found in our territory. The World Tree is attacking!"

"What?!"

Hualala!

The expressions of all the upper echelons of the Star Alliance present changed drastically, and they all stood up!

'Monster Synthesis Master', written by Zhuge Wanjun. The theme is quite interesting.

Description: Link, by accident, joined the ranks of the Starting Point army. Returning to the virtual reality MMORPG half a year ago, he became a nameless NPC in the game. Surrounded by dangers, he accidentally activated an artifact that can synthesize monsters.

[Gold] + [Mouse] = [Treasure Seeking Mouse]

[Metal] + [Desert Ant Nest] = [Silver Undead Marching Ant]

[Meteorite] + [Rotten Blue Whale] = [Biochemical Metal Leviathan]

Thus, a Monster Synthesis Master was born!

Link had the villain on his left and the player on his right. He was having a lot of fun harvesting leeks.

Six years later …

Link drove his Super Fortress and looked at the Starlight Devourer, Magic Energy Phoenix, Zerg Queen that he had personally created …

He wanted to cry but had no tears. "Three years after three years. Paul the Great, if you still don't appear, I will be treated as a boss by the players!"

(End of Chapter)
